conflicts_and_limits: Removing workflow permission declaration does not itself force zero permission; sample permissions:{} denial is significant.
Sample github-script uses mutable tag despite full-SHA recommendation.
job_workflow_ref not inherently always a SHA; actual exact identity and supported claims need verification.
Environment variable passing and event-origin inequality are mitigations, not complete sanitization or trigger provenance proof.
Signing and verified-creator badges are not human authorship or code safety proof.
Pinned hosted-isolation, Dependabot coverage and policy capability descriptions are not live verified eligibility.
